protocol: Preselected raw-score cutoffs, 3 original images per generator, 57 genuine photographs from distinct authors and source URLs. All 114 source IDs are disjoint from the earlier Frontier development set. The Instagram slice reuses 38 of those IDs and is measured separately. Offline WASM using the repository's Pillow fixture decoder. Failed decodes count as abstentions in the denominator. Wilson 95% intervals are approximate per slice. Site-wide precision, model-training independence and release criteria remain unverified.
